info.name: Money Manager API
info.description:
Complete API test collection for the Money Manager Laravel backend.

## Run Order
Run requests top to bottom within each folder. Tokens and IDs are saved automatically via test scripts.

## Prerequisites
1. Start XAMPP (Apache + MySQL)
2. In the backend folder run: php artisan migrate:fresh --seed && php artisan serve
3. API will be available at http://localhost:8000/api

## Seeded Accounts
- Admin: admin@admin.com / password
- Staff (Downtown): staff.downtown@example.com / password
- Staff (Northside): staff.northside@example.com / password
- Staff (Eastside): staff.eastside@example.com / password

## Collection Variables (auto-populated by test scripts)
base_url, token, staff_token, reset_code, card_account_id, cash_entry_id, card_entry_id, showroom_id, new_showroom_id, new_card_id, staff_id, new_staff_id, setting_id

item.name: 1. Auth
item.description: Authentication. Run admin login first, then staff login.

item.name: 2. Staff Operations
item.description: All use Bearer {{staff_token}}. Run Get My Card Accounts first to save card_account_id.

item.name: 3. Admin — Showrooms
item.description: All use Bearer {{token}}. Run List Showrooms first to save showroom_id.

item.name: 4. Admin — Card Accounts
item.description: All use Bearer {{token}}. Requires showroom_id from folder 3.

item.name: 5. Admin — Staff Management
item.description: All use Bearer {{token}}. Run List Staff first to save staff_id.

item.name: 6. Admin — Cash Entries
item.description: All use Bearer {{token}}. Requires cash_entry_id from folder 2.

exec: pm.test('Filtered by date range', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

item.name: 7. Admin — Card Entries
item.description: All use Bearer {{token}}. Requires card_entry_id from folder 2.

exec: pm.test('Filtered by date range', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

item.name: 8. Admin — Self-Transactions
item.description: All use Bearer {{token}}. Uses card_account_id from folder 2. Note: to_card_account_id is hardcoded to 2 — update if your seeded IDs differ.

item.name: 9. Admin — Settings
item.description: All use Bearer {{token}}. Run List Settings first to save setting_id.

exec: var target = settings.find(function(s) { return s.key === 'lock_hours'; }) || settings[0];
pm.test('Filtered by table name', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

item.name: 11. Admin — PDF Reports
item.description: All use Bearer {{token}}. Responses are application/pdf downloads. In Postman, save the response to a file to view the PDF.
